subject: science
skillName: Energy Transfers by Sound, Light, Heat, and Electricity

items.prompt:
Which can carry energy from place to place?
A) Sound
B) A rock sitting still
C) A drawing
D) A color

Heat energy moves from
A) cooler to warmer
B) warmer to cooler
C) it never moves
D) only through wires

steps: Heat always flows from warmer to cooler objects.

items.prompt:
A battery lights a bulb. The energy travels through the wires as
A) sound
B) an electric current
C) heat only
D) nothing

steps: Electric current carries the energy to the bulb.

items.prompt:
Sunlight warming your skin is energy transferred by
A) sound
B) light
C) electric current
D) a wire

steps: Light from the Sun carries energy that warms you.

items.prompt:
A speaker makes a window rattle. This is evidence that ____ carries energy.
A) sound
B) a magnet
C) color
D) weight

steps: Sound energy transferred to the window and made it move.

items.prompt:
A metal spoon in hot soup gets warm because
A) light moved into it
B) heat moved from the soup into the spoon
C) sound moved into it
D) electricity moved into it
items.answer: B) heat moved from the soup into the spoon

steps: Heat flows from the warmer soup to the cooler spoon.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) Light needs wires to carry energy
B) Light can carry energy through air or space without wires
C) Light carries no energy
D) Only wires carry energy
items.answer: B) Light can carry energy through air or space without wires

steps: Light travels and carries energy without needing wires.

items.prompt:
A pan handle on a stove gets hot without touching the flame because
A) sound heated it
B) heat traveled through the metal to the handle
C) light passed through it
D) it has a battery
items.answer: B) heat traveled through the metal to the handle

steps: Heat moves through the metal from the hot area to the handle.
